tools.name: Microsoft Co-pilot
tools.quote: We are aware of the challenges for students in relation to the digital divide and therefore recommend the use of Microsoft Co-pilot in relation to academic work.
Staff should note that tools designed to detect the use of GenAI are known to be problematic and therefore their use is not currently permitted by the University.

safeguards.quote: familiarity with the specific privacy policies or user agreements relating to their use. Students should be explicitly alerted to these policies whenever GenAI is to be used.
